description: Data for Land Subsidence Hazard and Building Collapse Risk in the Coastal City of Lagos, West Africa is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by University Libraries, Virginia Tech. The data contains 12 files: (1) InSAR data.csv contains the vertical land motion (VLM) and east-west in cm/year for Lagos, Nigeria. (2) Four GeoTIFF files containing the risk levels of Lagos for different year period (4 years, 10 years, 35 years, and 75 years). Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher University Libraries, Virginia Tech. Its tags are Geophysics, FOS: Earth and related environmental sciences, Environmental Science, 49999 Earth Sciences not elsewhere classified. The repository dates the deposit 2022; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
